summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Aspen Insurance Holdings Ltd, a Bermuda-based foreign private issuer, reporting unaudited financial highlights for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. It includes key metrics like gross written premiums, net income, combined ratio, and notes that on February 24, 2026, the company was acquired by a subsidiary of Sompo. The filing also mentions a March 2026 dividend declaration of $300M. This is a routine periodic earnings release, not a special-situation event triggering a separate category; the acquisition was previously consummated, so no active deal terms or new structural changes are detailed here.
